title: Application of Massachusetts Electric Company under the provisions of G. L. c. 164, § 94G 1/2 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. No. 528, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the Company's Oil Conservation Adjustment charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings taken in the billing months of April, May and June, 1995. The Oil Conservation Adjustment surcharge recovers the cost of conversion from oil-fired generation and its calculation is based on the respective costs of burning coal and oil.
filings: Second quarter 1995 fuel and adjustment charge calculation and conservation & Second quarter 1995 qualifying facility power purchase rate and Exhibits for Mass. Electric Co. by Thomas G. Robinson (95-10A)
Hearing notice issued to be held Tuesday, March 21, 1995, 10:00 am Saltonstall Bldg.
